name: Train Depot
summary: Beneath Gnomeregan's surface entrances in Dun Morogh, the Train Depot lies overrun by leper gnomes and troggs. Once a center of gnomish rail travel, it now stands in ruin.

sections.title: A Ruined Transit Hub
sections.body: The Train Depot lies below the grand elevator from Dun Morogh, where rail lines once carried gnomes through Gnomeregan. Its platforms and tracks now lie in ruin. The radiation that swept through the city changed the workers who remained into crazed leper gnomes, and troggs from below have overrun the rails. You must cross the depot to reach deeper parts of the city, including Clockwerk Run, the Loading Room, and the inner engineering facilities.

faq.q: Where is the Train Depot located?
aliases: how to get to train depot
faq.answer: The Train Depot lies beneath the surface entrance elevator in Dun Morogh, before the inner parts of Gnomeregan.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Train Depot now?
faq.answer: Feral troggs from the deep earth and leper gnomes driven mad by the radioactive disaster overrun the depot.

faq.q: Where do the paths from the Train Depot lead?
faq.answer: Passages lead west into Clockwerk Run and toward the Loading Room. A northern workshop has a back door leading down to the upper Engineering Labs.

faq.q: Who is hiding in the Train Depot?
faq.answer: Namdo Bizzfizzle, an engineering supplier, survives beneath the north side of the main platform on the depot's lower level.

angles.text: As an exiled gnome, you see the abandoned depot as a reminder of the advanced rail systems that once joined your subterranean city.
As an engineer, you can search the depot's lower platforms for rare schematics. Gnome peddlers such as Namdo Bizzfizzle still trade among the wreckage.
